extraction.name: LongVid
extraction.description: A large-scale long video instruction-tuning dataset comprising 114,228 long videos (lasting 300,000 hours) and 3,444,849 question-answering pairs (2 billion words of textual annotations) across five different task types: video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting.
extraction.creator: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhan Zhu, Haian Huang, Jianfei Gao, Kunchang Li, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Limin Wang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: LongVid curates videos and caption data from four existing open-source video datasets: Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-VILA, and MiraData, covering movies, egocentric videos, news, interviews, how-to videos, and in-the-wild videos. Dense event labels and QA pairs are generated based on video captions, event labels, and timestamps of short video segments.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-VILA, and MiraData, along with associated caption annotations from Ego4D-HCap, HT-Step, HowToInterlink7M, and Panda-70M.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Consecutive segments that can be regrouped into a long video sequence (more than 60s long) were filtered from the source subsets. A sequence of event labels with corresponding timestamps was constructed for every long video based on their captions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Dense event labels and multiple types of long video QA pairs were constructed across five categories: video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting. Annotations directly utilized existing high-quality event-level annotations (HT-Step, Ego4D-HCap) or used an open-source LLM (Qwen-72B) to extract event and background labels from captions.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and instruction tuning of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for long-context video modeling and understanding.
